page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8i.4xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated Intel Xeon 8475B vCPUs operating at a baseline frequency of 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps. There are no complimentary public IPv4 addresses included with this instance. The lack of local storage and the 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio represent a specific architectural tradeoff, prioritizing raw compute allocation over memory capacity and local disk performance.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and compute-heavy profile make this instance suitable for workloads that require consistent CPU performance without the overhead of shared-core environments. The resource distribution is optimized for compute-bound tasks rather than memory-intensive applications. Appropriate workloads include web serving, batch processing, application servers, and other compute-focused deployments that do not require high memory-to-CPU ratios or local SSD storage.
